faq.q: What text 'flavours' can it generate besides classic Lorem Ipsum?
faq.a: Six: Classic Latin (Lorem Ipsum), English readable, Hindi (Devanagari), Tech/Startup jargon, Corporate buzzword, and Pirate/Whimsical. You choose the count and whether to output paragraphs, sentences, words or a fixed number of characters, with options to vary sentence and paragraph lengths and to start with the traditional 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet'.

faq.q: Can it output HTML or Markdown instead of plain text?
faq.a:
Yes. Output formats are plain text, HTML with

wrapping, a structured HTML block (headings, paragraphs,

    /
      lists, a blockquote and a link), and Markdown (with a heading, list and blockquote). Quick presets set the whole combination — e.g. 'Blog intro (2 paragraphs)', 'Meta description (25 words)', 'Product card blurb', 'HTML block for a template' and 'Long page filler (20 paragraphs)'.

faq.q: Does it generate dummy data, not just filler text?
faq.a: Yes — the 'Dummy Data' tab generates test rows with columns name, email, phone, address, city, pin, company, jobTitle, date, uuid and sentence. You can toggle Indian names/addresses (or English), choose up to 500 rows, and download as JSON, CSV, or SQL INSERT statements. The data is randomly generated and fictitious, intended for testing only.

faq.q: How much text should I generate for a realistic layout test?
faq.a: Match the amount to the real content, not a comfortable excess — if a field will hold two sentences, test with two, since placeholder text hides length and empty-state problems. The tool regenerates live as you change the count (debounced) and remembers your settings. A character count and word count are shown, and you can copy or download the result as .txt.
